method: Post-two-review menu-only correctness check; no third ordinary review or rescore. Normal URL, real DOM bounds and click at three desktop sizes.

rows.text: OPERATOR HANDBOOK×MOVE WITH PURPOSE.Extraction uploads only inside the grounded floor ring. Outside pauses briefly; reenter before decay.W A S D MoveMOUSE LookLMB Fire coil rifleRMB Aim down sightsR ReloadSHIFT Soul Shift / dashCTRL SprintSPACE JumpHOLD E Recover nearby memoryESC Pause / release mouseSoul Shift protects briefly. Dash within 4.5 m of a charging enemy to cancel its shot and stagger it for 0.8 s. A blue emitter flash confirms the break. Dashing toward a charge stops early on a successful break so you can follow up. Sideways dodges retain full travel. It deals no damage; the 4.5 s cooldown still applies. Your shield regenerates when you avoid damage.THREAT VISOR · Orange optic bracket: charging. Muted: recent fire/hit. Lower readout follows one target near aim. Bearing chevrons merge enemy types: CHARGES counts charging enemies; SOURCES counts all eligible enemies there. Individual types/histories are omitted in groups. Clear optic line of sight required; cues expire. Full memories remain in the archive.UNDERSTOOD ↗
